records.subject: Current Affairs
records.description: Key outcomes and facts about the G20 Summit held in New Delhi.

deep_learning.concept_capsule: The G20 Summit 2023 (Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam) marked India's emergence as a global consensus builder. Key outcomes included the African Union's inclusion as a permanent member and the announcement of the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC).
practice_prompts: Analyze the geopolitical significance of the inclusion of the African Union in G20.
Discuss the strategic importance of the IMEC corridor for India's trade.

facts.fact_text: The theme of G20 2023 was 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam' (One Earth, One Family, One Future).
Bharat Mandapam was the venue for the G20 Summit in New Delhi.
National Science Day is celebrated on February 28th to mark the discovery of the Raman Effect.
